# Starter (JavaScript)

Welcome to your fresh **[Robo.js](https://robojs.dev)** project!

Build, deploy, and maintain your Discord bots with ease. File-based setup, integrated database, and plugin ecosystem.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
  <Card href="https://robojs.dev/discord" title="Discord" description="Robo - Imagine Magic" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/starter-js
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Development

Creating a **[Slash Command](/docs/discord-bots/commands)** is as easy as creating files.

<Files>
  <Folder name="src" defaultOpen disabled>
    <Folder name="commands" defaultOpen>
      <File name="ping.js" note="/ping" />
    </Folder>
    <Folder name="events" defaultOpen>
      <File name="ready.js" />
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
  <Folder name="config" defaultOpen disabled>
    <File name="robo.mjs" note="Main config" />
  </Folder>
  <File name=".env" />
</Files>

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "JavaScript"]} groupId="language" persist>
<Tab value="TypeScript">

  ```ts title="/src/commands/hello.ts"
  export default (interaction) => {
  	interaction.reply('Hello World!')
  }
  ```

</Tab>
<Tab value="JavaScript">

  ```js title="/src/commands/hello.js"
  export default (interaction) => {
  	interaction.reply('Hello World!')
  }
  ```

</Tab>
</Tabs>

Your `/hello` command is now ready to use!
